title: WPA Institute Global Aggregator · Source Intelligence Catalog

status_policy.CANDIDATE_VERIFICATION_REQUIRED: Named or discovered source; original publisher/root must be checked before activation.
status_policy.VERIFIED_OFFICIAL: Verified official root/feed. Set only after explicit check.
status_policy.FEED_CONNECTED: Verified source with a tested feed/API route.
status_policy.PUBLIC_PAGE_ONLY: Verified public publisher page; no automated feed claimed.

rules: WPA Media scope is limited to Protocol, Diplomacy, Public Relations, Security and Communicology.
A catalog entry does not verify every story from that source.
Official institutional material has primary evidentiary priority for the institution's own acts and statements.
Press-release wires preserve issuer claims and are not independent corroboration.
Podcasts, radio and directories are context/discovery unless separately corroborated.
No paywall bypass, credential bypass, prohibited scraping or private-data collection.
Political reporting remains neutral and factual; WPA does not endorse, rank or predict electoral choices.
Human Gate is required before consequential public release.

sources.name: United Nations · Manual of Protocol
sources.scope_boundary: Authoritative for United Nations Headquarters protocol practice and administrative/diplomatic procedures. The Manual itself states that it is not an exhaustive review of protocol matters and diplomatic etiquette.
sources.human_gate_note: For live operational use, confirm current UN forms, contact details, deadlines and procedures because administrative information and third-party references may change.
